localBiteReport: The most recent report with Choctawhatchee Bay/Destin inshore detail is from the week of September 18–24, 2026 (about 11 days old at time of writing). Capt. Adam Schroeder of Ignite The Bite Charters in Destin described the inshore bite as one of the best he has seen all year, driven largely by an abundance of bait that has become easy to locate early in the mornings. Redfish, flounder, and trout are all responding well and are the primary inshore targets right now around the bay. Water temperature at this location is 85°F. Early-fall conditions are setting up nicely for bay fishing, with bait schools pushing into shallower areas and game fish following — a pattern that typically holds and improves as September winds down.
